claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Zolantidine is a brain-penetrant histamine H2 receptor antagonist; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell viability because H2 receptor blockade is not a cytotoxic mechanism and no relevant off-target activity is reported.
